row_definitions_inspected.expected_behavior: Completion state is accurate and refresh-stable.
row_definitions_inspected.failure_evidence: Factory Today reported the setup checklist incomplete and did not recognize the completed costing consistently even after a quote, order, machines, workers, assignments, and payroll configuration existed.

row_definitions_inspected.expected_behavior: Shows selected date without mixing today’s values.
row_definitions_inspected.failure_evidence: The analytics historical date selector mixes historical and current values. Factory Today itself is today-only and has no historical date selector.

SETUP-011: Factory Today setup checklist state is built by lib/factory-today-checklist.ts instead of duplicated inline client-facing logic.
Completed costing is recognized from a qualities row, estimator quote, order, or market run so quote/order-backed costing is not missed.
Loom target completion now requires a linked active order relation instead of any non-null current_order_id.
Day/night loom assignment completion requires both shifts for the same machine with worker IDs.
Piece-rate and fixed-worker setup counts use active workers only.
Payroll config completion validates the same cycle/pay/reminder bounds enforced by migrations.
DASH-004: app/(dashboard)/owner/actions/dashboard.ts now builds trend data through getDailyMeterTrend for both live and historical selected dates.
fetchHistoricalData returns a complete DashboardData-shaped object with today, orders, and machines set to null and a trend scoped to the selected date.
DashboardClient uses setData(history) for historical dates instead of merging over previous current state.
Returning to today refreshes live today, orders, workerBreakdown, machines, and trend.
Current-only order and machine cards render only when selectedDate is today.
